overview.text: Larry Thompson is an attorney, talent manager, and film producer seeking to represent California’s 32nd Congressional District. He is the founder and president of the Larry A. Thompson Organization, a talent management and production studio based in Los Angeles; his campaign says he has managed the careers of over 250 stars and produced films and television programs. Thompson earned a law degree from the University of Mississippi and served in the U.S. Army Reserve’s Judge Advocate General’s Corps from 1968 to 1974.
